headline: Approved liquor license renewal for Stewart's Shop #526 and new liquor license for Jamaican Taste, 177 Church Street.
summary: The commission adopted the consent agenda, which included approving the 2026-2027 Second Class Store Liquor License Renewal for Stewart's Shop #526 at 1555 North Avenue. It also approved the 2026-2027 First Class Liquor License Application for Jamaican Taste at 177 Church Street, with conditions including a record check and Fire Marshal approval.
decisions: Approved the consent agenda, including the liquor license renewal for Stewart's Shop #526, 1555 North Avenue.
Approved the First Class Liquor License Application for Jamaican Taste, 177 Church Street, with conditions including a record check and Fire Marshal approval.
